response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with strong web/full-stack, DevOps, and D-language expertise, plus a personal geospatial (GIS) project, but his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js and web platforms rather than modern C++ or Rust. His only substantial C++ work was nearly a decade ago at National Instruments, and there's no evidence of distributed-systems, routing, tiling, or navigation-specific production experience, making him a weak match for a role centered on C++/Rust routing pipeline engineering.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Personal open-source GIS/geo-data platform (GISCollective) shows genuine interest and some geospatial domain exposure
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new stacks and technologies across many past roles
concerns: Minimal recent (or even historical) hands-on C++ experience; no Rust experience mentioned
No demonstrated experience with routing algorithms, tiling pipelines, or navigation guidance systems in a production context
Current and recent roles are focused on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work, not systems-level or distributed backend engineering matching this role's core needs

key_factors.factor: Personal GIS project and adaptability across stacks
